svg.title: Successor and limit steps in transfinite recursion
svg.desc: Extending compatible partial functions; Successor stage: one new input; f on β → f ∪ {(β, H(f))} on β + 1; H reads the entire earlier function f.; The old input-output pairs remain unchanged.; Limit stage: join all earlier histories; fδ ⊆ fε (δ < ε < λ); fλ = ⋃δ<λ fδ; Agreement on overlaps makes the union a function.; Replacement first collects the shorter functions.; Only stages inside the specified ordinal are constructed.
